derivation: Offline orthographic triangle rasterization of the existing OBJ. Body paint recolored silver gray; original mesh geometry and material segmentation retained. Synthetic studio illumination and ground shadow added.
display_contract: Static ego-vehicle symbol only. It does not encode measured ego pose, yaw, lane position, speed, detected make or model.
runtime: Loads the pre-rendered RGBA PNG only, with size-specific LRU cache; no runtime 3D model parsing or rendering.
asset_license_scope: The local npm package includes this mesh under its package MIT license; no separate asset-specific license is supplied in the package.
